description: Shell script for checking authentication status of Claude Code and OpenClaw, including token expiry and service status.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches JSON status from openclaw models command.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates token status based on expiry timestamp.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Extracts expiry timestamp for Claude CLI profile from JSON.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Extracts maximum expiry timestamp for any anthropic profile from JSON.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Determines the best anthropic profile ID based on expiry.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of API keys for the anthropic provider.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks the status of Claude Code authentication token.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the status of OpenClaw authentication.
